name: fullscan-forced-single-producer
body: FullScanReason::Forced is produced only by incremental::prepare(force = true); delta::plan never emits it. Limit: the variant is a prepare-level signal, so a future caller needing a forced rebuild must thread the force signal rather than expect delta::plan to produce this reason. Upgrade when a second producer path, or a consumer other than cmd_scan's reason log, needs the same verdict.
